# The tests' team

A small team the suite runs the machinery on: two workflows, `dev` (implement ⇄ review → ship) and `triage` (plan → a
condition routing to build-web, build-backend or a handoff to `dev` → notes), the three agents their steps name, and one skill for each. It is test data, never shipped: Nemia ships no workflows, agents or skills, and nothing
pins a team a person builds to this one. Change it only for what a test needs.
